steps.name: environment - verify runtimes and install workspace-local supabase CLI deterministically
steps.description: Validate Python (>=3.10), Node (>=18) and npm (>=8). Ensure a deterministic workspace-local npm prefix at WS/.local, pin and install supabase CLI v1.67.0 into WS/.local, verify binary exists at either WS/.local/bin/supabase or WS/.local/lib/node_modules/.bin/supabase. Parse --version --json output using a small Python JSON parser fallback to text parsing only if JSON unavailable. Optionally write an idempotent /etc/profile.d/dev_tools.sh exposing WS/.local/bin when EXPORT_GLOBAL_ENV=true. All operations are non-interactive, idempotent, and operate in the authoritative workspace path.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/business-income-and-expense-tracker-40762-40773/income_expense_backend"
cd "$WS"
PY_MIN_MAJOR=3; PY_MIN_MINOR=10; NODE_MIN_MAJOR=18; NPM_MIN_MAJOR=8
PY_V=$(python3 -c 'import sys;print(f"{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}")')
PY_MAJ=${PY_V%%.*}; PY_MIN=${PY_V##*.}
if [ "$PY_MAJ" -lt "$PY_MIN_MAJOR" ] || { [ "$PY_MAJ" -eq "$PY_MIN_MAJOR" ] && [ "$PY_MIN" -lt "$PY_MIN_MINOR" ]; }; then echo "python3 >=3.10 required (found $PY_V)" >&2; exit 11; fi
NODE_V=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -z "$NODE_V" ]; then echo "node not found" >&2; exit 12; fi
NODE_V=${NODE_V#v}; NODE_MAJ=${NODE_V%%.*}; if [ "$NODE_MAJ" -lt "$NODE_MIN_MAJOR" ]; then echo "node >=18 required (found $NODE_V)" >&2; exit 13; fi
NPM_V=$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -z "$NPM_V" ]; then echo "npm not found" >&2; exit 14; fi
NPM_MAJ=${NPM_V%%.*}; if [ "$NPM_MAJ" -lt "$NPM_MIN_MAJOR" ]; then echo "npm >=8 required (found $NPM_V)" >&2; exit 15; fi
# ensure deterministic workspace-local npm prefix
mkdir -p "$WS/.local" "$WS/.local/bin" "$WS/.local/lib"
# prefer system supabase if present
SUP_SYS=$(command -v supabase || true)
if [ -n "$SUP_SYS" ] && [ -x "$SUP_SYS" ]; then echo "$SUP_SYS"; exit 0; fi
# install pinned supabase CLI into workspace-local (pin to 1.67.0), retry once on failure
SUP_VER_PIN="1.67.0"
npm_args=(--silent --no-audit --no-fund)
# Use --prefix to force install location; validate both bin locations after install
if [ ! -x "$WS/.local/bin/supabase" ] && [ ! -x "$WS/.local/lib/node_modules/.bin/supabase" ]; then
  npm --prefix "$WS/.local" i "supabase@${SUP_VER_PIN}" "--save=false" "${npm_args[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
    npm --prefix "$WS/.local" i "supabase@${SUP_VER_PIN}" "--save=false" "${npm_args[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  }
fi
# verify binary in known locations
if [ -x "$WS/.local/bin/supabase" ]; then SUP_BIN="$WS/.local/bin/supabase"; elif [ -x "$WS/.local/lib/node_modules/.bin/supabase" ]; then SUP_BIN="$WS/.local/lib/node_modules/.bin/supabase"; else echo "supabase CLI not found at workspace-local locations" >&2; exit 20; fi
# parse version robustly: prefer --version --json parsed by python
SUP_VER=$($SUP_BIN --version --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("version",""))' 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$SUP_VER" ]; then SUP_VER=$($SUP_BIN --version 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/[^0-9]*\([0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 || true); fi
if [ -z "$SUP_VER" ]; then echo "warning: could not determine supabase CLI version; expected ${SUP_VER_PIN}" >&2; else
  ver_ge(){ [ "$(printf '%s\n%s' "$1" "$2" | sort -V | head -n1)" = "$2" ]; }
  if ! ver_ge "$SUP_VER" "$SUP_VER_PIN"; then echo "supabase CLI $SUP_VER < required $SUP_VER_PIN" >&2; exit 21; fi
fi
# optionally persist PATH to /etc/profile.d if requested (idempotent)
if [ "${EXPORT_GLOBAL_ENV:-false}" = "true" ]; then
  TMPF=$(mktemp)
  cat >"$TMPF" <<EOF
# workspace-local tools
export PATH="$WS/.local/bin:":"$PATH"
export NODE_ENV=development
EOF
  if ! sudo test -f /etc/profile.d/dev_tools.sh || ! sudo cmp -s "$TMPF" /etc/profile.d/dev_tools.sh; then sudo cp "$TMPF" /etc/profile.d/dev_tools.sh; fi
  rm -f "$TMPF"
fi
# output chosen binary path for downstream automation
echo "$SUP_BIN"

steps.name: dependencies - create venv, install python deps and optional node deps reliably
steps.description: Create a Python venv at WS/.venv and install pinned requirements into it. If pip build for psycopg2-binary fails, install libpq-dev and gcc then retry. Ensure sqlite data file exists. Install node helpers into WS/.local only if package.json declares dependencies or when NODE_INSTALL=yes; do not swallow npm errors. Create symlinks to workspace-local bin safely (guard globs). Validate that venv uvicorn exists and matches pinned version; prefer venv uvicorn for runtime.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/business-income-and-expense-tracker-40762-40773/income_expense_backend"
cd "$WS"
PYVENV="$WS/.venv"
[ -d "$PYVENV" ] || python3 -m venv "$PYVENV"
"$PYVENV/bin/pip" install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel -q
TMPLOG=$(mktemp)
if ! "$PYVENV/bin/pip" install -r "$WS/requirements.txt" -q >"$TMPLOG" 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libpq-dev gcc -qq >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  "$PYVENV/bin/pip" install -r "$WS/requirements.txt" >"$TMPLOG" 2>&1 || (cat "$TMPLOG" >&2; rm -f "$TMPLOG"; exit 31)
fi
rm -f "$TMPLOG"
# ensure sqlite data file exists
mkdir -p "$WS/data" && touch "$WS/data/dev.sqlite"
# optional node installs: only when package.json exists and NODE_INSTALL is true
if [ -f "$WS/package.json" ] && [ "${NODE_INSTALL:-false}" = "true" ]; then
  npm --prefix "$WS/.local" i --no-audit --no-fund --silent --no-save || { echo "npm install failed" >&2; exit 33; }
  mkdir -p "$WS/.local/bin"
  shopt -s nullglob || true
  for f in "$WS/.local/lib/node_modules/.bin"/*; do ln -sf "$f" "$WS/.local/bin/$(basename "$f")"; done
  shopt -u nullglob || true
fi
# verify venv uvicorn binary and version matches pinned uvicorn
if [ -x "$PYVENV/bin/uvicorn" ]; then
  UV_BIN="$PYVENV/bin/uvicorn"
  UV_V=$("$UV_BIN" --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/.*\([0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 || true)
  if [ -z "$UV_V" ]; then echo "could not determine venv uvicorn version" >&2; exit 34; fi
  if [ "$UV_V" != "0.22.0" ]; then echo "venv uvicorn version $UV_V does not match pinned 0.22.0" >&2; exit 35; fi
else
  echo "uvicorn missing from venv; ensure pip install succeeded" >&2; exit 36
fi

fi

import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
import tempfile
import sqlite3
import requests
load_dotenv(dotenv_path=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', '.env'))
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    r = client.get('/health')
    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json().get('status') == 'ok'

def test_db_connectivity():
    db_dsn = os.getenv('DATABASE_URL') or os.getenv('POSTGRES_DSN')
    if db_dsn:
        import psycopg2
        conn = psycopg2.connect(db_dsn, connect_timeout=5)
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute('SELECT 1')
        assert cur.fetchone()[0] == 1
        cur.close(); conn.close()
        return
    sup_url = os.getenv('SUPABASE_URL','').strip()
    anon = os.getenv('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY','').strip()

steps.name: validation - build/start app, readiness loop with total timeout, health-check, stop cleanly
steps.description: Start the FastAPI app using venv uvicorn (required) inside its own process group using setsid to enable robust cleanup. Capture logs to a temp file, wait for readiness with bounded total timeout and controlled backoff, perform health HTTP check, then stop the server by killing the process group and remove logs. Provide log tail on failure for evidence. Operates in the workspace and validates start/stop and health endpoint responsiveness.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/business-income-and-expense-tracker-40762-40773/income_expense_backend"
cd "$WS"
PYVENV="$WS/.venv"
if [ -x "$PYVENV/bin/uvicorn" ]; then UV_BIN="$PYVENV/bin/uvicorn"; else echo "uvicorn missing from venv" >&2; exit 50; fi
LOGFILE=$(mktemp)
# start uvicorn in its own process group via setsid
setsid "$UV_BIN" app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --log-level warning >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$PID" | tr -d ' ')
trap 'if [ -n "${PGID:-}" ]; then sudo kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; rm -f "$LOGFILE"' EXIT
# readiness: bounded total timeout
TOTAL_TIMEOUT=30; SLEEP=0.5; ELAPSED=0
while true; do
  if curl -sS -f http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  if (( $(echo "$ELAPSED >= $TOTAL_TIMEOUT" | bc -l) )); then echo "server failed to become ready within ${TOTAL_TIMEOUT}s" >&2; echo "--- uvicorn log (tail) ---" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOGFILE" >&2; sudo kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit 51; fi
  sleep $SLEEP
  ELAPSED=$(echo "$ELAPSED + $SLEEP" | bc -l)
  SLEEP=$(python3 - <<PY
s=$SLEEP
s=s*2
print(s if s<=5 else 5)
PY
)
done
# perform a health check and print response
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health || true
# stop server cleanly by killing the process group
sudo kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f "$LOGFILE"
echo "validation successful"
